option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom described in the vignette, but it is not a specific disease diagnosis and is unrelated to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) involve vascular malformations, but they are genetically distinct from Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, which is caused by mutations in ENG or ACVRL1 genes.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a localized finding, not a systemic disease, and is not equivalent to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, although epistaxis is a common manifestation of HHT.

Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes with different clinical features and etiologies compared to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
